market_summary: Broader risk-off and USD strength dominates the London/NY Overlap session. Equities (US100), crypto (BTCUSD), and metals (XAUUSD) are all heavily extended below their respective daily VWAPs and Value Area Lows with bearish CVD. EURUSD and GBPUSD remain compressed inside value near POC. US100 presents an actionable bearish continuation break below local support, while Gold and Bitcoin are overextended into low ATR bands, favoring wait-and-see pullback discipline.

signals.rationale: VP context shows price is well below VAL (3947.11) and POC (3978.35). CVD is strongly BEARISH (-8.31, slope -3.55), confirming persistent aggressive sell-side order flow during the active LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Trend is firmly bearish below VWAP (3960.92) and EMA50 (3952.99). The signal candle penetrated beyond the lower ATR band (3911.74) with elevated RVOL (1.911) backed by recent yellow volume spikes. While the market is structurally oversold, the forming candle swept Session Low (3884.62 down to 3882.79) without buying absorption; however, price is heavily stretched >2 ATR below baseline without consolidation, creating poor immediate location for a short. HOLD until an intraday pullback to value.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / steep extension below declining session VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection / breakdown below previous Session Low 3884.62

signals.rationale: Price is trading inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10801, VAH 1.10976) and hovering right near POC (1.10928). CVD is NEUTRAL (+4,771 vs 117k volume) with mixed delta slope. In the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session, price is tightly coiled around VWAP (1.10861) and EMA50 (1.10884). Candles are oscillating mid-channel between ATR bands (1.10737 - 1.11013) with no yellow RVOL spike (last RVOL 1.697). Holding support above Prev Low (1.10824) but lacking directional momentum away from fair value. Classic inside-value chop dictates HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral / oscillating around flat VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance / consolidating between S/R 1.10824 and Session High 1.11027

signals.rationale: Price is positioned inside the session Value Area (VAL 1.32593 to VAH 1.32778) and trading below POC (1.32738). CVD indicates net BEARISH delta (-5,833) with negative slope (-1760), but price action shows no downside expansion, instead consolidating directly across VWAP (1.32656) and EMA50 (1.32677). ATR bands (1.32497 - 1.32804) bracket price symmetrically mid-channel. RVOL is muted at 1.063 with no breakout volume. The market is respecting Prev Low support (1.32618) during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP without directional resolution. Confluence mandates HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral / trapped around flat VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (28081.85) and POC (28120.74). CVD is BEARISH (-3.27), matching directional pressure during the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Structurally, price is holding cleanly below both VWAP (28121.69) and downward-sloping EMA50 (28130.78). Signal candle and live forming bar have sliced below the lower ATR band (27953.94) and cleared local support at 28030.0. Accounting for the Dukascopy US100 index CFD tick volume caveat (where RVOL > 2.0 rarely triggers), the break is cleanly structured with strong directional momentum heading toward Session Low (27912.13). High-probability continuation scalp.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / downward trend continuation below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance / breakdown through support S/R 28030.0 toward Session Low

signals.rationale: Price is trading firmly below VAL (73260.85) and POC (73517.38). Cumulative Delta is BEARISH (-0.07, slope negative), agreeing with the strong down-move. Occurring in LONDON_NY_OVERLAP, price remains heavily rejected below VWAP (73371.34) and EMA50 (73264.39). While recent yellow RVOL spiked on the initial flush, the live forming bar dropped to an extreme of 72055.2 and is currently pinned below the lower ATR band (72397.07) at Session Low (72155.8). Entering a short directly at the multi-sigma extended low after a 1200+ point drop poses adverse mean-reversion risk. Prudent discipline warrants HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / heavy trend displacement below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance / breakdown below lower ATR band and Session Low 72155.8 sweep
